alternatives_rejected.why: Their huge error z-scores look downstream: currencyservice's inbound calls go from 0 to 17% errors with 4.39x latency (E2), and its own latency p90 rises 4655% (E1, E3).

Inbound latency is up 4.39x while own self-time is nearly flat (E2), which fits a socket fault too. Delay alone would not explain the 715% socket metric deviation (z=143, E3) or the new inbound errors (E2).
Inbound errors fit loss, but the distinctive resource signal is the socket metric (z=143, E3), not a pure network signal.
The mem deviation is much weaker (z=30.47 vs socket z=143.11, E3), and own span self-time barely changes (1.24x, E2).

proposed_fix.description: First inspect currencyservice socket and connection usage: open fds, TIME_WAIT, connection pool and ulimit. Then find and stop whatever is exhausting sockets, raise fd/connection limits if needed, and do a rolling restart of the currencyservice pods to clear leaked sockets. Watch inbound error rate and p90 latency return to baseline.
